After `seed_instance(1618)`, the test calls `company()` (which parses a `formats` template through `generator.parse`), `catch_phrase` (which samples from each tuple in `catch_phrase_words`), and a successful `company_suffix()`. The final `fake.company_suffix()` enters `faker/providers/company/__init__.py::Provider.company_suffix` (lines 515–519), which returns `self.random_element(self.company_suffixes)` on an empty sequence. What exact exception type and exception message are thrown as an uncaught exception from that `company_suffix` invocation (i.e., the exception that propagates out of the company provider and is caught by the test harness)?
